reading.title: The Impact of Remote Work on Urban Development
reading.passage: The rise of remote work has fundamentally transformed urban development patterns. As companies embrace flexible work arrangements, fewer employees commute to downtown offices, reducing demand for commercial real estate in city centers. Consequently, some urban areas have experienced economic challenges, while others have adapted by converting office spaces into residential apartments and entertainment venues. This shift prompts cities to reconsider their infrastructure investments and urban planning strategies to remain competitive in an increasingly distributed workforce economy.

questions.q: According to the passage, what is one consequence of increased remote work?
options: Reduced commercial real estate demand in city centers
questions.explanation: 본문에서 'fewer employees commute to downtown offices, reducing demand for commercial real estate in city centers'라고 명시되어 있습니다. 따라서 도시 중심부의 상업용 부동산 수요 감소가 정답입니다.

questions.q: How have some cities adapted to these changes?
options: Converting office spaces into residential apartments and entertainment venues
questions.explanation: 지문의 'converting office spaces into residential apartments and entertainment venues'에서 도시들이 사무실 공간을 주거 및 엔터테인먼트 시설로 전환했다고 설명하고 있습니다.

questions.q: What does the passage suggest cities must do?
options: Reconsider infrastructure investments and urban planning strategies
questions.explanation: 'cities to reconsider their infrastructure investments and urban planning strategies'라는 표현에서 도시들이 인프라 투자와 도시 계획 전략을 재검토해야 한다고 제시하고 있습니다.

writing.prompt: Do you agree or disagree with the statement: Remote work has more advantages than disadvantages for employees and employers?

structure.intro: 명확한 입장 표현 (동의/불동의)과 주요 이유 2가지를 간단히 소개합니다. 예: 'I strongly agree that remote work offers more benefits than drawbacks for both parties because it increases flexibility and reduces overhead costs.'
structure.body1: 첫 번째 주요 이점 설명. 예: 직원의 업무-생활 균형 개선, 출퇴근 시간 절감, 생산성 향상 등을 구체적인 예시와 함께 설명합니다.
structure.body2: 두 번째 주요 이점 설명. 예: 회사의 운영비 절감, 채용 지역 확대, 직원 유지율 증가 등을 논리적으로 전개합니다.
structure.conclusion: 입장을 재확인하고, 원격 근무가 미래 직업 환경에 미칠 긍정적 영향을 요약하며 마무리합니다.

speaking.prompt: Some people prefer working in an office environment with colleagues. Others prefer working remotely from home. Which do you prefer and why?
useful_expressions: In my opinion, I prefer remote work because...
One reason is that remote work allows me to...
Another advantage is that I can...
In conclusion, remote work better suits my lifestyle because...
sample_points: 원격 근무의 유연성과 개인 시간 활용 가능성: 출퇴근 시간 절감, 점심 시간 자유로움, 업무 일정 자체 조정 가능
집중력 증진과 방해 요소 감소: 사무실의 소음과 불필요한 회의 줄어들어 실제 업무에 집중할 수 있음

listening.title: Campus Career Services Discussion
listening.script: Student: Hi, I'm interested in learning about remote internship opportunities. I've been struggling to find positions near campus. Career Advisor: That's a great question! Remote internships have become much more common, especially in tech and marketing fields. Many companies now offer flexible arrangements for students. Student: That sounds promising. What are the main advantages? Career Advisor: Well, you can gain experience without relocating, and you'll often have better work-life balance. Plus, remote positions tend to offer competitive compensation. However, you might miss some face-to-face mentoring. Student: I see. Do employers value remote internships? Career Advisor: Absolutely! Most employers recognize that remote interns develop strong communication and self-management skills. These are highly valued in today's workplace. I'd recommend checking our online database for current listings.

questions.q: What is the main purpose of this conversation?
options: To discourage students from pursuing internships
To discuss the advantages and considerations of remote internships
To explain why on-campus internships are better
To recruit the student for a specific company
questions.explanation: 진학 상담가와 학생이 원격 인턴십의 장점(유연성, 보상, 기술 개발)과 단점(대면 멘토링 부족)에 대해 논의하고 있으므로, 원격 인턴십의 여러 측면을 다루는 것이 대화의 주목적입니다.

questions.q: According to the career advisor, what skills do remote interns develop?
questions.explanation: 상담가가 'remote interns develop strong communication and self-management skills'라고 명시적으로 설명하고 있습니다.

questions.q: What does the career advisor suggest the student do?
options: Apply immediately to a specific company
Check the online database for current remote internship listings
questions.explanation: 대화의 마지막 부분에서 상담가가 'I'd recommend checking our online database for current listings'라고 학생에게 온라인 데이터베이스를 확인하도록 권장하고 있습니다.
